description: The concierge persona over the agent-ui base: one BookingForm titled "Book your stay" as the surface root, its aggregate two-way bound to /booking: required arrival and departure dateSingle fields, a required room-type select (king, twin or junior suite) and a breakfast Yes / No choice, all starting unanswered. Its child Book now Button is a submit action, so the form holds it until every required field is filled, and its context carries /booking; the surface also sends its data model, so the guest's choices reach the agent. No confirmation renders on the request turn: the read-back belongs to the turn after the submit.
name: domain-concierge-booking-request
promptText: I'd like to book a room at the hotel. Let me pick my dates, the room type and whether I want breakfast.

description: The hospitality domain over the agent-ui base: one Itinerary titled "Lisbon, 3 days" as the surface root, its days bound to /trip/days. Day 1 (arrival) is done; day 2 (Belem) is under way, one stop active and the rest pending, with a weather aside; day 3 (Sintra) is pending, with an exchange-rate aside. Each stop carries its time, a label, an optional detail line and its status. One bound path, so the plan updates in place as legs are chosen; the Itinerary is read only, with no Button inside it.
name: domain-hospitality-itinerary-trip
promptText: Lay out my three days in Lisbon: what is done, what is on today and what is next, with the weather and the exchange rate.
